description: Dependency direction checked by dependency-cruiser: layer order, closed modules, no import cycles and no UI library in the layers of pure computation

rules.description: A layer imports only from the layers below it. List the layers from top to bottom in options, each with a name and a folder
Code outside a closed module imports only its public files. List the module folders in options (* stands for each folder at that place) and the public files, relative to the module folder
Disallow import cycles (cycles made only of type imports are allowed)
The layers of pure computation do not import UI libraries. Name the layers (from the options of dependency-cruiser/layer-order) in options
